purpose: DfCM-maximal, evidence-bounded adaptation of APS into composable portable Agent Skills with deterministic GGen reconstitution.
governingInvariants: SELECT, CONSTRUCT, and DO are separate authority classes.
Generated projections do not become semantic authority merely by existing.
Authority inversion requires byte-equivalence proof before predecessor projections are demoted.
Novel qualified mechanisms should be promoted into reusable knowledge.
nonClaims: Repository conformance does not grant production actuation authority.
Skill text does not prove its operational claims until executed against an admitted subject.
A successful export alone does not prove GGen manufacture.
A successful GGen equivalence run does not by itself make an uncommitted exported ontology the canonical source.
